third_party_evaluations.summary: Malware static/dynamic analysis with reverse-engineering report.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Practical static/dynamic analysis and a reverse-engineering report establish a focused malware specialization; three-year experience and catalog recognition do not imply general incident-response seniority.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Practical static and dynamic malware analysis with a reverse-engineering report establishes a focused DFIR specialty. The three-year profile and NICCS context do not make this a general incident-response seniority step.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded practical static and dynamic analysis with a reverse-engineering report validates a distinct malware-analysis branch. Specialty reflects that focused technical depth better than a general professional-career promotion.
